response.justification: While Bogdan demonstrates strong experience in distributed systems, large-scale infrastructure, and platform architecture—notably his work at Dunnhumby handling millions of requests per second and building GISCollective—he falls critically short on a minimum qualification: only ~1-2 years of C++ programming experience versus the required 8 years. His career has been primarily polyglot (TypeScript, Node.js, D, Java) with C++ as a peripheral technology. Additionally, there is no clear evidence of formal technical team leadership or mentoring of engineering teams, which are central to this role.
strengths: Strong distributed systems and large-scale infrastructure expertise from Dunnhumby and GISCollective platforms
Proven ability to architect and own complex technical platforms end-to-end (GISCollective, Fluent-Asserts, Trial)
Track record of technical mentoring through workshops, talks, and open-source contributions to the developer community
concerns: Only ~1-2 years of C++ experience against the stated minimum requirement of 8 years—a critical gap
No demonstrated experience formally leading or mentoring engineering teams; teaching experience is community-focused, not organizational
Limited explicit cloud architecture and compute platform specialization compared to role's focus on internal cloud infrastructure strategy
